prompt:
MANDATORY FRAMING: reserve a generous clean margin of at least 80 pixels on ALL FOUR canvas edges. Every object including the longest sword point, spear point, arrowhead, bow ends, helmet top and boot toes must be fully inside the inner 85 percent safe area. Scale the whole layout down to fit. Never crop any tip, handle or footwear. Keep full silhouette and visible whitespace around every object. Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE exceptionally clear original fantasy hunting equipment design sheet on an off-white studio background, landscape 3:2, high-detail hand-painted production concept rendering matching earthy gray-green leather, dull bronze fixtures, physically believable creature-derived materials. This is a NEW equipment sheet, NOT a monster portrait. Exactly ONE fully clothed ADULT neutral mannequin/hunter on the left third, full body visible from low fitted helmet to boots, calm front three-quarter stance, empty hands, practical unisex armor with five distinct regions (helmet, torso, forearms, waist, legs), covered torso, no exposed thighs, no exaggerated sexual anatomy. Open face, short low silhouette, free elbows/wrists/knees, hands and fingers visible. On the other two thirds show exactly SEVEN separate weapon groups in a clean organized 4+3 grid, each completely in frame, clear separation and enough empty space. Mandatory weapon groups: 01 large single-edged heavy sword; 02 short single-edged sword PLUS a separate small shield; 03 a long-handled hammer with CLOSED HARD striking faces, not a drum; 04 TWO matching short blades as one pair; 05 ONE long slender gently curved sword; 06 ONE long straight spear PLUS a separate long shield; 07 ONE slim working bow with a single taut string and a SMALL aiming ring plus one arrow. Do NOT omit any weapon family. Exact tiny text below groups only: 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07. No titles, Japanese letters, paragraphs, dimensions or ornamental UI. No monster body on the sheet. Soft material shadows only, no scenery, no flames or magical VFX obscuring shapes. The mannequin must not hold any weapon. Not a collage of existing pictures; render a coherent new collection.
Series 006: ルミスカ / 燐尾. This sheet shows its native rank 1 only. Creature identity: 細い二足体の後ろへ、太い燐節を連ねた長尾が伸びる Functional organ: 尾の節ごとに蓄電層と鈍い燐光板をもつ燐節器。電気を出す節から先に光り、尾先と地面の間に短い放電路を作る。 Palette: 青灰／琥珀の点光／濃茶. Overall armor silhouette: 細く前へ傾いた輪郭。背骨に沿って光る節の列。後ろへ伸びる偏り.
Armor regions: head: 細い額当ての後ろへ小さな燐節を一個埋め、冠状に盛らない; chest: 細い光皮の胸当て、背骨の線に沿って小燐節を三つ縦に固定; arms: 前腕外側に尾板の薄い列、手の甲へ短く先細りにする; waist: 腰背面の帯に尾板を二枚、前腰には蓄電器官をぶら下げない; legs: 脛へ細い放電尾板を添え、踵は丈夫な革で低く支える.
Weapons in fixed order: 01: 細い放電板を大きな片刃の峰へ三段に配し、刃面は灰金属色; 02: 小さい尾板の短剣と、背面に蓄電膜を封じた先細り盾; 03: 扁平な硬い槌頭の側面へ燐節二点、打面に発光孔を開けない; 04: 同長の細刃二本、鍔の小燐節を左右対称にする; 05: 細い曲刀の峰に燐節を間隔を空けて三つ埋める; 06: 尾板の直線槍先と、縦一列の燐節を備えた細い盾; 07: しなやかな弓身と握り上の照準環、環の片側だけ小燐節一個.
Native-grade material treatment: 背の三節と小さい琥珀光。武器の燐節は刃元へ集める. All armor is adult-sized even if materials come from a juvenile species. Preserve the small rounded juvenile material vocabulary where applicable, not child-sized clothing. Equipment sheets are illustrative concept art, not orthographic engineering diagrams.
review: 低い燐板兜と胸・腕・腰・脚、7武器群を確認。薄い鱗と琥珀色の点状発光、硬い閉鎖槌面、盾2枚、双剣2本、弓弦・小照準環・矢あり。剣先・槍先・足先を含め全パーツが画面内。
